course.about: 12/3 in the twenties aura with a 9 beside it
course.text: "There could have been a tendency sometimes to speak before sensing the environment, and that what you said to either be taken badly by others, or to fall flat because the timing was off."

inner.lowerLeft=12|inner.lowerRight=9.worst: Says it bluntly (9) at the wrong moment and feels misunderstood (12/3).
